title: apps/desktop: Tauri shell ships CSP disabled with whole-home-directory fs scope
description: apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json:26 sets security.csp = null and capabilities/default.json:6-16 grants fs:allow-read-file/write-file/exists with fs:scope-home-recursive. This is a Flash clone that opens untrusted .fla files and joins untrusted collab sessions; any script-injection foothold in the authoring webview (or a future dependency XSS) then has unrestricted read/write over the entire ~ home directory, and csp:null removes the primary in-webview mitigation. Fix: set a real security.csp (script-src 'self', etc.) and narrow the fs scope from /home/justin/** to project/document dirs or a dialog-granted scope. At minimum flag home-recursive as a pre-production hardening item. Confidence: confirmed.
